name: android-preferences
description: Drives the preferences example on an Android device or emulator and captures the presenter's own pixels. Self-provisioning: the launch block boots an AVD if no device is attached, installs, enables inspection, starts the activity and forwards the port, so this is one command from a cold machine.

launch.//: NativeActivity has no command line, so the opt-in gate is a system property read by pkg/mobile at package init. It must be set before the process starts, which is why the launch order is setprop, force-stop, then am start.

//: Toggling the checkbox exercises the DrawLine path: a checked box draws its tick as two diagonal segments, exactly the case the GLES presenter used to fill as a solid block. The captures make that visible rather than inferred.
//budgets: Android timings are recorded, not gated. There is no baseline for this scene yet, and a budget invented before a measurement is a guess with a threshold attached.
